MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Agreement is entered into as of March 1, 2026 between Northwind Analytics Inc. ("Disclosing Party") and Bluepeak Consulting LLC ("Receiving Party").

1. CONFIDENTIALITY
Each Party agrees to hold the other Party's Confidential Information in strict confidence using reasonable efforts, a term left undefined in this Agreement.

2. TERM
This Agreement continues until December 31, 2027, unless earlier terminated upon thirty (30) days' written notice.

3. PAYMENT
No fees are payable under this Agreement.
